# sse-proxy — LLM doc index (pinned: image 1.1.2; main is ahead — RBAC scoping #6 and the
# module-identity migration are unreleased because the v1.2.0 tag shipped no artifact).
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release (bare-semver tags only, no v prefix).
# The deployed Helm chart is NOT in this repo: clickstack-chart charts/krateo-sse-proxy.
docs/index.md: the map — what sse-proxy is + links to the whole bundle; the release-state note
docs/overview.md: how it works — ClickHouse poller, in-memory hub/topics, opt-in auth + RBAC scoping, gated OTel
docs/usage.md: how it reaches a cluster — installer via clickstack-chart, standalone helm, deploy/ manifest, local run
docs/configuration.md: every env var with defaults + how the deployed chart wires them (auth/scoping/OTel off in stock)
docs/api.md: the HTTP/SSE contract — /events, /notifications, /health, SSEK8sEvent, failure modes, metrics
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: bare-semver tag → shared image build; rollout via clickstack-chart; the no-op crds-job convention
docs/log.md: curated history (incl. the v1.2.0 no-artifact tag and the 1.1.1 involvedObject.uid filter fix)
examples/events-snapshot/README.md: one-shot Job printing the GET /events JSON snapshot (URL from the endpoint Secret)
examples/events-snapshot/job.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
examples/notifications-stream/README.md: one-shot Job streaming raw SSE frames from GET /notifications for 30 s
examples/notifications-stream/job.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
# Code-adjacent internals (authoritative): the package/file doc comments in the nine Go files.
main.go: poller + hub + HTTP surface (pollSQL, topics, /events query building, SSE handler)
auth.go: opt-in HS256 JWT validation (snowplow-identical), token acceptance order, context identity
rbac.go: SubjectAccessReview-derived namespace scoping — fail-closed, cached, stdlib-only kube client
telemetry.go: gated default-off OTel setup (OTEL_ENABLED master + per-signal overrides)
metrics.go: the three sse_proxy_* instruments
logging.go: always-on JSON slog with trace correlation
deploy/deployment.yaml: standalone reference manifest incl. the ServiceAccount RBAC scoping needs
